en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Sandal, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: On the fifteenth of Sha’bān, a caller calls out from the highest horizon: O those who have come to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.)! Return forgiven and your rewards will be given (to you) by your Lord and by Muḥammad (s.a.a.w.), your Prophet.
